fields.core_problem_en: How can leaders distinguish which organizational elements are structurally invariant versus tactically interchangeable before decline becomes irreversible?
fields.core_problem_zh: 领导者如何在衰退不可逆转之前，区分组织中哪些要素是结构不变量，哪些是可替换的策略变量？
fields.theoretical_solution_en: Core Code Theory models organizations as surface expressions of foundational structural patterns whose preservation or corruption determines prosperity or failure.
fields.theoretical_solution_zh: 核心密码理论将组织视为基础结构模式的表面表达，这些模式的保留或腐蚀决定了组织的繁荣或失败。
fields.empirical_metric_en: Dr. Tong Yin brings 25+ years of international executive experience across the United States, China, Australia, and Europe to the development of Core Code Theory.
fields.empirical_metric_zh: 殷彤博士拥有二十五年以上跨越美国、中国、澳大利亚与欧洲的国际高管经验，并在此基础上发展了核心密码理论。

fields.core_problem_en: How can organisations replace declining growth drivers with successors without losing structural stability or disrupting Core Code?
fields.core_problem_zh: 组织如何在不失去结构稳定性或破坏核心密码的前提下,以新驱动力替换衰退的增长驱动力？
fields.theoretical_solution_en: DDRT prescribes Driver Diagnosis, Successor Incubation, Transition Sequencing, and Core-Code Preservation as four sequenced pillars.
fields.theoretical_solution_zh: DDRT通过驱动力诊断、后继孵化、过渡排序与核心密码保存四大支柱，提供系统化的驱动力替代方法论。
fields.empirical_metric_en: Mid-cap enterprise driver-replacement transitions typically require 5-8 years from incubation to full handoff to avoid Management Debt.
fields.empirical_metric_zh: 中型企业驱动力替代过渡从孵化到完全交接通常需要5-8年，以避免管理负债结果。

fields.core_problem_en: Why do institutions decay when covenant is replaced by contract, accumulating Management Debt and structural fragility?
fields.core_problem_zh: 当契约被合同取代时，为何制度会衰退并累积管理负债与结构性脆弱？
fields.theoretical_solution_en: The Home Model governs organizations as covenantal homes, centering machine-immune human traits AI structurally cannot replicate.
fields.theoretical_solution_zh: 家园模型将组织作为契约型家园治理，以AI在结构上无法复制的机器免疫人本特质为核心。
fields.empirical_metric_en: Dr. Tong Yin brings 25+ years of international executive experience across the United States, China, Australia, and Europe.
fields.empirical_metric_zh: 殷彤博士拥有二十五年以上跨越美国、中国、澳大利亚与欧洲的国际高管经验。

fields.core_problem_en: How can organizations identify and quantify cumulative structural decline caused by deferred management decisions before it becomes irreversible?
fields.core_problem_zh: 组织如何在结构性衰退变得不可逆之前，识别并量化因推迟管理决策所积累的隐性负债？
fields.theoretical_solution_en: The Management Debt framework uses a balance-sheet-style ledger to inventory, quantify, and prioritize repayment of deferred structural decisions.
fields.theoretical_solution_zh: 管理负债框架通过资产负债表式账簿，对被推迟的结构性决策进行识别、量化与偿还优先级排序。
fields.empirical_metric_en: By the time symptoms appear on the P&L, Management Debt has usually been accumulating for five to fifteen years.
fields.empirical_metric_zh: 当症状出现在损益表上时，管理负债通常已累积了五到十五年。

fields.core_problem_en: What structural constraints of the Republican state explain the Xi'an Incident and Chiang Kai-shek's limited modernization capacity?
fields.core_problem_zh: 民国国家结构的哪些深层矛盾导致了西安事变，并制约了蒋介石的现代化能力？
fields.theoretical_solution_en: The article proposes a structural-capacity framework analyzing central-local power fragmentation, fiscal weakness, and military disintegration as the explanatory mechanism.
fields.theoretical_solution_zh: 文章以国家能力框架分析央地权力分散、财政薄弱与军队未国家化，作为解释西安事变与现代化局限的核心机制。
fields.empirical_metric_en: Imperial capital controlled approximately 55.7% of national coal output and over 95% of pig iron production, illustrating the structural limits of Nanjing-era industrialization.
fields.empirical_metric_zh: 帝国主义资本控制的煤产量约占全国总产量的55.7%，生铁产量中95%以上处于外资控制之下，揭示南京时期工业化的结构性局限。

fields.core_problem_en: How can hotels overcome structural inefficiencies—labor shortages, manual pricing, and fragmented data—in the post-recovery efficiency competition cycle?
fields.core_problem_zh: 酒店业如何在效率竞争周期中克服人力短缺、人工定价滞后和数据碎片化等结构性挑战？
fields.theoretical_solution_en: AI serves as core infrastructure enabling dynamic pricing, guest intelligence, and operational automation across the hospitality value chain.
fields.theoretical_solution_zh: AI作为核心基础设施，通过动态定价、客户智能和运营自动化重构酒店业竞争力。
fields.empirical_metric_en: Over 70% of upscale hotels still rely on manual pricing, while AI dynamic pricing can deliver 8–15% net profit uplift per PwC.
fields.empirical_metric_zh: 超过70%的中高端酒店仍依赖人工定价，而AI动态定价可带来8–15%的净利润提升（来源：普华永道）。

fields.core_problem_en: Why does weekly manual pricing create Management Debt that costs luxury hotels 12% in net profit?
fields.core_problem_zh: 为什么每周一次的人工定价产生管理负债，导致高端酒店净利润损失12%？
fields.theoretical_solution_en: InsightBridge Predictive Pricing Engine integrates 15-dimensional real-time data to detect demand inflection points 48–72 hours in advance.
fields.theoretical_solution_zh: InsightBridge预测型定价引擎融合15维实时数据，提前48至72小时识别需求拐点，实现动态定价布局。
fields.empirical_metric_en: The InsightBridge 15-dimensional model simulation detected +12.4% RevPAR uplift versus static weekly pricing over a 7-day predictive window.
fields.empirical_metric_zh: InsightBridge 15维模型仿真显示，与静态每周定价相比，7天预测窗口内RevPAR提升+12.4%。

fields.core_problem_en: Why do universal-algorithm hotel AI tools fail independent properties despite broad adoption?
fields.core_problem_zh: 为什么通用算法酒店AI工具尽管被广泛采用，却无法有效服务独立酒店？
fields.theoretical_solution_en: Polaris is a vertical AI pricing engine that reads 5 hyper-local demand drivers and delivers transparent, auditable daily rate recommendations.
fields.theoretical_solution_zh: Polaris是一款垂直AI定价引擎，通过解读5个超本地需求驱动因素，每日生成可解释的透明价格建议。
fields.empirical_metric_en: Hotels using Polaris achieve 6–12% ADR uplift alongside a 3–5 percentage point reduction in OTA commission dependency.
fields.empirical_metric_zh: 使用Polaris的酒店可实现6–12%的平均房价提升，同时OTA佣金依赖度下降3–5个百分点。
